Q: How to use VBA to read a file A:

Tim

The file can be opened in Wordpad ( file snippet is inserted below, == indicates a comment added by me).

The first part of the file is configuration / calibration data. The second part is a series of numbers, each of which is a reading from an A/D converter.

The calibration / configuration information will be used to convert the A/D readings into tension measurements.

The VB macro will use the data in the file to create a two dimensional array ( weight, time offset ).

The last step will be to create a chart showing tension and time offset
